What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `bearssl`: BearSSL upstream 7bea48e (v0.6-39), unchanged in webcpp's pin 32381d6: bearssl_hmac.h states constant time for br_hmac_outCT alone; br_hkdf_* (src/kdf/hkdf.c) calls br_hmac_out.
* `botan`: Botan 3.14.1: doc/api_ref/kdf.rst states no constant-time property of its KDFs, and their source (src/lib/kdf/) none.
* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.
* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man7/EVP_KDF-HKDF.pod and EVP_KDF-PBKDF2.pod state no constant-time property.
* `sodium`: libsodium 1.0.22: its headers state constant time for comparisons (sodium/utils.h) alone, not for its hashing, MAC, key derivation and password hashing functions (crypto_hash_*, crypto_xof_*, crypto_generichash_*, crypto_shorthash_*, crypto_auth_*, crypto_kdf_*, crypto_pwhash_*).
* `webcrypto`: The Web Cryptography API (W3C Recommendation, 2017) states no constant-time property of digest, sign or deriveBits; each JavaScript runtime's implementation decides, and webcpp reads none.

The default of `hkdf_extract` and `hkdf_expand`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `botan`, `openssl`, `sodium` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `hkdf`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `bearssl`, `botan`, `openssl`, `sodium` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `hkdf_extract` over pieces, `hkdf_expand` over pieces and `hkdf` over pieces: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links (<<hash-default-backend>>).

`webcrypto` serves the asynchronous family alone, on Emscripten, where the type of its asynchronous call names it (<<hash-async-webcrypto>>).
